scope: Three remaining closeout native follow-up producers are now integrated into the canonical default family cells. Independent historical predicates and shared DOM readers remain authoritative. This records source/protocol testing, not actual packed/native family qualification.

diagnostics.scope: Complete canonical default tabs/select/chips/form-field browser probe under explicit DOM/style/geometry/control/timer protocols. Shared actual predicates and DOM readers execute; no browser, Angular/forms/legacy instances, packed artifact, AOT or consumer floors are qualified.

Complete canonical tooltip/menu/autocomplete browser probe with DOM/timer/lab protocols and real promise scheduling; generated consumer syntax only. No browser, directive/node DI, packed artifact, actual Angular compiler templates, or floor qualification.

Complete canonical snack probe under explicit DOM/CSS-event/clock protocols. Shared actual readers, trace ownership and predicate execute. No browser, actual Angular/legacy lifecycle, CSS engine, packed artifact, AOT or floors qualified.

pointer_driver.scope: CDP and BiDi commands target the existing owned session/context. GTK native pointer simulation requires a newly spawned private Xvfb and a matching private display marker; no user desktop DISPLAY is used. Failed input or obsolete request acknowledgment fails closed.

chromium_observation.scope: One minimal HTML page proves actual trusted CDP click and focus retention under preventDefault; no Angular, Material, packed artifact, release matrix or floors. Same unchanged pointer helper used by both branches.
chromium_observation.timing: Observed before final comments/formatting and the code commits; no subsequent pointer-driver behavioral change.

pointer_driver.webkitgtk_native: unexecuted; local Xvfb missing; no install attempted

outlined_field: Filled/hint presence retained; actual outlined first/prefix/rendered-hide/show/RTL observations use original 0.75 label scale and 5px notch padding arithmetic, both start/gap pairs, direction and prefix transitions. Public BidiModule applies the actual injected Directionality in the generated consumer. Long-label cap/attachment differences remain open.
pagination: Original exact semantics, zero initial scroll, disabled-click inertness after two frames, focused first label, fresh button coordinates, one trusted click, negative scroll and retained focus are required. A signal epoch creates a fresh narrow header each canonical cell; the original ink-bar sequence remains required.
snack_motion: Shared enabled test-override fixture wraps the actual owned handler without changing timers or routing. Both event and suppressed-actual-CSS-event fallback modes require one trusted enter/exit/action, correct delivery origin, fallback deadlines, action dismissal, completion and removal. Owned listeners/input requests clean up on completion or replacement. Direct pending announcement destruction remains separate.
runner_deadlines: Each existing wait phase retains its 1.5s or shorter limit. The bounded whole-cell deadline is 12s for sequential states, replacing a 4.8s loop that could terminate before a permitted multi-stage probe finished. WebKit IPC requests now have a 10s bound and child failures reject pending requests.

other_checks.note: One initial source-completion run lacked NODE_PATH and failed to resolve borrowed TypeScript; rerun with the same borrowed path passed on both lines. No assertion was relaxed.
